query_text: I decided to sell part of my memorabilia collection. The decision didn't come easily, as I have spent years curating and organizing pieces that hold sentimental value and evoke fond memories of my time spent collecting them. However, the reality of my living space becoming increasingly cluttered made it clear that a change was necessary to maintain peace of mind and harmony in my environment. I found that I had been holding onto these physical items for too long, while what truly excites me now are the endless possibilities offered by digital mediums. The shift in my focus toward digital film experiences allows me to immerse myself in storytelling and creativity without the physical limitations of tangible items.
